requirements.title: CFI_allocate has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h allocation interface
requirements.definition: CFI_allocate has the interface int CFI_allocate(CFI_cdesc_t *dv, const CFI_index_t lower_bounds[], const CFI_index_t upper_bounds[], size_t elem_len) and allocates memory for a descriptor-described object.

pending.CFI_allocate-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares lower and upper CFI_index_t arrays, and compiles an ordinary CFI_allocate call that returns int.

requirements.title: CFI_allocate actual arguments must specify an unallocated allocatable or pointer descriptor
requirements.definition: The descriptor shall specify rank and type, have a null base_addr, preserve element length for noncharacter type, and have allocatable or pointer attribute; nonzero rank calls require lower and upper bound arrays, and character allocation takes elem_len from the argument.

pending.CFI_allocate-descriptor-null-base-rank-t: C companion first uses CFI_establish to create an unallocated rank-two allocatable int descriptor with null base_addr and type CFI_type_int before allocation.
pending.CFI_allocate-attribute-allocatable-or-po: Use one allocatable descriptor and one pointer descriptor established with null base_addr; both positive controls call CFI_allocate and assert CFI_SUCCESS without relying on allocation addresses.
pending.CFI_allocate-bounds-arrays-present-for-p: For rank two, pass lower {1,10} and upper {2,12}; source-control mutation replaces one bound array by null and remains a nonconforming no-diagnostic negative.
pending.CFI_allocate-character-elem-len-argument: Character companion establishes a null allocatable CFI_type_char descriptor, calls CFI_allocate with bounds {1}:{3} and elem_len 5, and asserts the descriptor elem_len becomes 5 after CFI_SUCCESS.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_allocate allocates storage and applies supplied bounds and character length
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_allocate uses the Fortran ALLOCATE mechanism, assigns allocated memory to base_addr, uses supplied lower and upper bounds for each dimension, ignores bound arrays for rank zero, and uses supplied elem_len for character type.

pending.CFI_allocate-success-base-address-nonnul: C companion establishes an unallocated allocatable int descriptor, calls CFI_allocate with lower {1,10} and upper {2,12}, asserts CFI_SUCCESS and nonnull base_addr, stores distinct values through CFI_address, then reads them back.
pending.CFI_allocate-supplied-bounds-override-di: After the same allocation, assert dim[0].lower_bound is 1, dim[0].extent is 2, dim[1].lower_bound is 10, and dim[1].extent is 3; expected extents are 2-1+1 and 12-10+1.
pending.CFI_allocate-rank-zero-ignores-bounds: Rank-zero allocatable int descriptor receives nonnull sentinel lower and upper arrays containing 77; after CFI_allocate returns CFI_SUCCESS, assert base_addr is nonnull and no dimension member is read.
pending.CFI_allocate-character-length-overrides: Character allocation companion pre-establishes elem_len 1, calls CFI_allocate with elem_len 5, and asserts elem_len is 5 plus CFI_address offsets adjacent elements by 5 bytes.

requirements.title: Detected CFI_allocate errors preserve the descriptor
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_allocate error, the C descriptor is not modified.

pending.CFI_allocate-detected-error-preserves-de: C companion establishes a pointer descriptor over local int storage so base_addr is non-null while rank, type, attribute, elem_len, and bounds are otherwise valid for allocation; before CFI_allocate it snapshots base_addr, elem_len, version, rank, attribute, type, and every dim lower_bound, extent, and sm member, calls CFI_allocate with lower {1} and upper {3}, and asserts the returned indicator is CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NOT_NULL from 18.5.4 Table 18.5 plus every snapshotted descriptor member is unchanged.

requirements.title: CFI_allocate returns an error indicator
requirements.definition: The result of CFI_allocate is an error indicator.
